sequence_gate.policy: The exact preregistered immutable model snapshot and pinned public code dependencies may be prefetched and cryptographically verified without inference. Digest-bound five-seed and nine-seed P2 core audits plus the five-seed and nine-seed confirmatory causal audits must finish before natural-suite benchmark payload acquisition, baseline selection, dataset generation, or any prediction. Native and fixed external baselines still run if the calibrated candidate does not qualify.

common_protocol.conditional_arm_rule: fixed+pins and calibrated+pins require both a passed P2 causal gate and an architecture-preserving port with prediction/cache equivalence. Qwen3 has no DeepSeek sparse-attention pin/indexer contract, so these arms are recorded as incompatible unless such a port is separately validated; native and fixed Qwen baselines remain mandatory.
common_protocol.quality_memory_pairing: quality comparisons use the same example and measured hot-resident-byte target

statistics.paired_unit: the frozen benchmark example; for SCBench, the complete (mode, task, shared-context row) conversation cluster rather than an individual turn
statistics.interval: percentile paired cluster bootstrap of the conservative score difference; SCBench resamples shared-context rows and recomputes the turn-weighted mean, while other benchmarks resample examples
statistics.two_sided_p: twice the smaller bootstrap tail probability with plus-one correction
statistics.multiplicity: report all five benchmark-specific intervals and p-values; do not replace them with one pooled significance claim

measurement_reporting.arm_distributions: mean, sample standard deviation, p50, p95, p99, minimum, and maximum over scored examples; retain all-terminal distributions separately
measurement_reporting.failure_policy: retain failed attempts in failure rates and all-terminal physical contrasts; never impute them into scored-only latency or memory distributions

RULER.migration: Regenerate the same frozen tasks with the Qwen3-4B tokenizer; do not reuse Qwen3-1.7B token-length labels for 64K or 128K.

execution.tokenization_boundary: tokenize the full rendered prompt once, slice only at its stable context-token prefix, and hash both the raw prompt and exact token-id sequence; never reuse 1.7B length labels
execution.dataset_binding: bind all five Qwen3-4B length-specific dataset manifests as one SHA-256 digest set in every arm cell
execution.scorer_binding: verify the pinned KVPress RULER scorer SHA-256 and record both official and local scoring implementation digests
execution.operational_failure_policy: retain explicit failure and include as zero in the conservative all-expected quality mean
execution.hot_memory_measurement: exact bytes in DynamicCache key/value tensors immediately after prefill compression and before question decoding

SCBench.scoring: Use the pinned task-specific official scorers; report every task and turn before any macro average.

execution.resume_unit: one atomically published turn prediction within one reconstructable shared-context row
execution.multi_turn_cache: compress the first rendered prompt once; retain every official golden-answer follow-up prompt while removing generated answer tokens
execution.multi_request_cache: compress one shared context once; restore that exact cache after every independent query
execution.upstream_deviation: do not apply upstream 128K truncation; classify every oversized turn as unsupported-context without model execution
execution.tokenization_boundary: preserve the pinned official rendered segment boundaries and bind both rendered-string and exact token-id sequence digests
execution.operational_failure_policy: retain every one of 10,286 turn records per arm and include each failure as zero in the conservative all-expected quality mean
execution.hot_memory_measurement: exact bytes in DynamicCache key/value tensors after each turn prompt is ingested and before answer-token decoding

LongBench-v2.upstream_deviation: Disable pred.py head-tail truncation and deterministic sampling; report fit-only strata separately until all 503 examples fit.

execution.invalid_answer_policy: score zero under the official parser; do not exclude from quality
execution.operational_failure_policy: retain explicit failure and include as zero in the conservative all-expected quality mean
execution.hot_memory_measurement: exact bytes in DynamicCache key/value tensors immediately after prefill compression and before question decoding

official_judge.unavailable_action: report_official_metric_blocked; auxiliary deterministic metrics may not replace it

LongMemEval.primary_metric: official LLM-judge accuracy overall and by question type

execution.history_boundary: all orig-session natural-language history is retained; no retrieval, compression, or truncation before model context-fit classification
execution.paid_judge_policy: never invoke the paid official judge implicitly; explicit openai mode requires OPENAI_API_KEY
execution.blocked_judge_policy: retain the local model response, generation stop reason, generated-token count, and physical measurements as a judge-blocked terminal failure scored as zero in the conservative mean; do not substitute an auxiliary score
execution.judge_provenance: for an official score retain the raw judge prompt and response, requested and returned model, response id, created timestamp, and judge latency
execution.tokenization_boundary: tokenize the full rendered history-plus-question prompt once and slice only at its stable context-token prefix
execution.operational_failure_policy: retain explicit failure and include as zero in the conservative all-expected quality mean
execution.hot_memory_measurement: exact bytes in DynamicCache key/value tensors immediately after prefill compression and before current-question decoding

MRCR.generation_reserve_rule: ground-truth answer token count plus 32 tokens

scorer.metric: difflib.SequenceMatcher ratio after exact alphanumeric-prefix gate

MRCR.reporting: Report every needle-count by token-bin cell; do not allow shorter bins to hide 64K-128K failure.

execution.operational_failure_policy: retain explicit failure and include as zero in the conservative all-expected quality mean
execution.hot_memory_measurement: exact bytes in DynamicCache key/value tensors immediately after prefill compression and before final-query decoding
execution.tokenization_boundary: tokenize the full rendered chat once and slice only at its stable context-token prefix

fixed_baseline_selection.criterion: maximum row-weighted mean RULER accuracy; lexicographic arm name breaks exact ties
fixed_baseline_selection.freeze_rule: selection occurs on the completed 1.7B matrix before any Qwen3-4B natural prediction
fixed_baseline_selection.label_semantics: strongest-memory-matched-fixed is a legacy frozen-selection arm label, not a claim that the selected algorithm uses fixed allocation; PyramidKV and AdaKV candidates allocate adaptively
fixed_baseline_selection.selection_inference_boundary: descriptive tuning-set ranking only; no winner-vs-runner-up significance claim; the Qwen3-4B natural suite is the held-out transfer evaluation

FlashMemory-DeepSeek-V4.action: run only in the separately provisioned official DSA evidence tier; never project its result onto Qwen3

IndexCache.supported_architecture_boundary: DeepSeek Sparse Attention models such as DeepSeek-V3.2 or GLM-5
IndexCache.action: compare only on a supported DSA runtime in the official/large-model tier

suite_audit.terminal_definition: every expected example is either scored or represented by one explicit unsupported-context, OOM, timeout, empty-generation, invalid-answer-format, judge-blocked, or runtime-error record

claim_boundary: This suite tests transfer on a pinned compatible Qwen3 model. It is not official DeepSeek-V4 evidence, and unsupported or incompatible cells remain explicit rather than being imputed.
